title: Amla (Nelli Kai): modeled ₹544/qtl left, Kattappana → Kottakkal
summary: February 2024: reported amla (Nelli Kai) prices at Kattappana and Kottakkal imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 95% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹544 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 6 same-variety market pairs screened for amla (Nelli Kai) in February 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kottakkal report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2024
scenes.caption: Kattappana (Kerala) and Kottakkal (Kerala) both reported amla (Nelli Kai) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 19 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kattappana reported a median ₹4,500 per quintal. Kottakkal reported a median ₹5,650 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,050/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,050 per quintal, and Kottakkal was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 254 km by road
scenes.caption: 254 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹55/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹451 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹147 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kottakkal report, the rule selects 19 of 19 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹544 per quintal (₹241 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Amla (Nelli Kai) route from Kattappana to Kottakkal was positive on 95% of matched days in February 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹54,400, or ₹24,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to amla (Nelli Kai)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹55/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Amla (Nelli Kai) route from Kattappana to Kottakkal was positive on 95% of matched days in February 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹54,400, or ₹24,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

RBI Working Paper WPS (DEPR) 08/2024 — Price Dynamics of Tomato, Onion and Potato
